title: RAI Planner with HVE Core
description: Use RAI Planner on a support chatbot, then use hve-builder to add your team's policy and plan conventions.
sourceNote: Product details reflect the October 1, 2026 snapshot: HVE Core 7e2de1a and the linked VS Code documentation. Both walkthroughs are scripted illustrations, not recorded agent runs. Contoso, its policies and its systems are fictional. SR 26-2 is real interagency guidance, paraphrased with links to the official text.
